name: Nanakawa Mika
source:
She is a childhood friend of Yuuki and Maiko and belongs to the cheerleading club. She is a mischievous, friendly, outgoing girl with an innocent, silly, but lovable personality.

She is much older than Yuuki, but they have been playing together like siblings since they were little. 

Since the cheerleading club is short of members and cannot participate in the contest, she plans to force Yuuki to dress up as a woman and join.

She is a member of the cheerleading squad, so she does a lot of outdoor activities, but she maintains her miraculously fair skin.

She is a troublesome girl who turns into an “S” when it comes to sex.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180121082105/https://7thdoor.x.fc2.com/HP/7th_index.html]official site[/url]]
